marker: # unit_length and ref_repeats are Table 3 and Table 1 of Matamoros et
# al. 2011: Table 3 gives the consensus repeat unit and its length, and Table 1 gives the NCC2705 MLVA
# profile, 6-4-3-7-16 in this locus order. ref_size is the product these primers give in the NCC2705
# assembly GCA_000007525.1, which lies inside the published size range of every locus. A run on
# NCC2705 returns the published profile with a residual of zero at every locus. VNTR12 can take a half
# repeat allele, 2.5 or 5.5, as the paper notes; NCC2705 is a whole 6.
# patterns is N/A at every locus: counting the published consensus motif in the NCC2705 amplicon does
# not return the published copy number at any of the five, because the arrays are imperfect and the
# flank carries partial motifs, so a stored pattern would raise a false COUNT_DISAGREES. The motifs
